question: Where’s the closest restaurant in the direction from AT&SF NO.940, Bartlesville, OK to Center For Orthopaedic Reconstruction And Excellence, Jenks, OK?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%AT&SF NO.940%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bartlesville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OK%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Center For Orthopaedic Reconstruction And Excellence%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Jenks%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OK%' LIMIT 1 ), target_direction AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry::geography, e.geometry::geography)) AS azimuth FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city, p.cuisine FROM pois p, start_point s, target_direction td WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography, 100000) -- Search within 100km radius for performance AND LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography)) - td.azimuth), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography)) - td.azimuth) ) <= 15 -- Within +/- 15 degrees of the target direction ORDER BY ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
